title: Deflect surcharge is not paid when an opponent chooses Galio from a multi-candidate target prompt of a triggered ability.
expected: chain/resolve.ts:453-466 filters options by Deflect affordability and at :517-530 sets a choose-target pendingChoice for >=2 options WITHOUT paying; only the single-candidate else-branch at :531-539 calls payAnyDomainPower(getDeflectSurcharge(...)). The comment at resolve.ts:450-452 claims the multi-candidate pick "still owes its surcharge at pick time (choose-target branch of pending-choice.ts)", but game-definition/moves/pending-choice.ts:1236-1267 (the plain choose-target resolution) just builds effectCtx with boundTargets=[picked] and calls executeEffect — no getDeflectSurcharge/payAnyDomainPower anywhere in pending-choice.ts (grep confirms zero references). So a prompted triggered-ability pick of Galio applies the effect without deducting power.
observed: Player-2 pool before pick {mind:0,fury:1}; resolvePendingChoice pickedCardId=Galio succeeded, effect applied to Galio (mightModifier -2 from Blastcone Fae; Ganking granted by Gem Jammer), pool after pick still {mind:0,fury:1} both times. Affordability gating does work (with 0 power Galio was excluded from Solari Shieldbearer's options), but pending-choice.ts never calls payAnyDomainPower/getDeflectSurcharge — only the auto-bound single-candidate branch in chain/resolve.ts charges.

history.note: Fix requires editing pending-choice.ts, which currently carries ~300 lines of another lane's uncommitted work depending on an untracked play/spell-modes.ts; shipping it would ride along/break HEAD. Edit reverted. Shape is known: carry deflectTax on the choose-target prompt from chain/resolve.ts and pay getDeflectSurcharge at pick time.
